notes: Memory saves properly now, and the app closes when you tell it to.

changelog.headline: What's new in 1.0.7

sections.title: Memory
items: It remembers things you tell it again. The installed app was missing the file that tells it what is worth keeping, so every single thing you said was quietly dropped.
Favourites, ratings, people, plans, all of it sticks now.

sections.title: Closing the app
items: Quit actually closes everything, including the floating dot. Nothing is left running in the background.
Old copies no longer keep floating on screen after an update.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. This update only replaces the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
